gumroad_listing.title: New Florida LLCs & Corps — May 2026 — 15,997 Records (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
Every business entity registered in Florida in the last 30 days (Apr–May 2026). 15,997 records sourced from the Florida Division of Corporations (sunbiz.org) — the same public registry used by ZoomInfo, D&B, and every commercial data vendor, at a fraction of the price.

**What's included:**
- Entity name
- Entity type (Florida LLC, Profit Corp, Non-Profit, Foreign LLC, Limited Partnership, Trust)
- State of registration (FL)
- Filing date (chronological — target April filers before everyone else)
- Registered agent name and address
- Principal business address as filed with Florida SOS
- sunbiz.org source URL for every row

**Important notes:**
- Officer/organizer name field is NOT included in this release (data quality issue in source — field preserved in schema for future releases)
- Principal address may be a home address for home-based businesses (standard for SOS filings — same as all commercial vendors)
- Buyer is responsible for CAN-SPAM / TCPA compliance when using this data for outreach

**Who buys this:** Insurance agents, bookkeepers, CPAs, web designers, registered agent services, payroll companies, and business banking reps — anyone who needs to reach brand-new Florida businesses in their first 30-60 days.

**Data source:** Florida Division of Corporations (sunbiz.org) — public government record, no auth bypass.

Gumroad listing must describe principal_address as 'registered business address as filed with Florida SOS — may be home address for home-based businesses'
